name: WallHax
tagline: Shared AR for responders: see teammates through walls, drop threat pins and map floors together.
problem: Teams clearing buildings lose track of each other and of hazards.
solution: iOS devices stream positions and LiDAR-detected walls; teammates appear as avatars and pins sync across devices, with Gaussian-splat reconstruction.
demo_moment: Team-described: walk a floor while a teammate's avatar shows behind a wall.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best AI & Data Science” among 231 submissions.
Shares the map across the team in real time.

lessons: Multi-device sync is the impressive part of AR.
